title: Coordinated disturbances haunt grids worldwide. Here’s how researchers solved the mystery. | TechCrunch
summary: Every 60 seconds, the frequency on the grid would drop a tiny bit. To find evidence that UPSes were the main culprit on the grid, Witthaut and his team turned to data provided by grid operators.
